name: Ollama AI Studio
description: Local-first LLM inference playground for Ollama: list models, pull weights, execute chat completions, and generate embeddings with zero API fees.

commands.title: List Local Ollama Models
commands.description: Queries /api/tags on the local Ollama server to inspect available quantized models.

commands.title: Run Local LLM Completion
commands.description: Sends a prompt to Ollama /api/generate with deterministic temperature control.

commands.title: Generate Vector Embeddings
commands.description: Computes embeddings via Ollama /api/embeddings for pgvector/Qdrant RAG pipelines.
